site_schema.summary: The structured data presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering and software-delivery company, contrary to its approved staffing and recruiting positioning. It also advertises unsupported service promises and misstates service names, timelines, guarantees, and insurance.

llm_problems.title: Old Applied AI positioning
llm_problems.issue: The schema positions GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Replace the Applied AI Engineering positioning with the approved company description and remove claims that present GoGloby as an engineering or software-delivery partner.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers

locations.quote: Applied AI Engineering Partner

llm_problems.title: Development services no longer offered
llm_problems.issue: The service catalog sells generative AI development and delivery, including building copilots, agents, and RAG applications, which is outside GoGloby’s staffing and recruiting offers.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the development-services offer and its delivery claims from the schema.

llm_problems.fix: Remove or correct the geographic scope to match the documented services.

llm_problems.title: Unverified founder claims
llm_problems.issue: The claims that Vit Koval spent a decade scaling teams across the listed regions and generated $60M+ in value are not supported by the Fact Sheet.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported tenure, geography, and value claims or verify them with the company before use.
llm_problems.subject: Vit Koval

locations.quote: For the past decade, has helped engineering leaders scale teams
generating $60M+ in value.

llm_problems.title: Unverified vetting superlative
llm_problems.issue: The claim that GoGloby vets the world’s most thoroughly vetted talent is an unsupported superlative; the Fact Sheet states that approximately 4% of candidates pass its assessment.
llm_problems.fix: Remove the unsupported superlative and use only documented assessment claims.
llm_problems.subject: Vetting claim

locations.quote: the world's most thoroughly vetted talent

llm_problems.title: Unverified staffing speed promises
llm_problems.issue: The 72-hour profile delivery and first-feature-in-3-to-5-business-days promises are not documented; the stated staffing time is 2–3 weeks to start.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify these speed promises and align any staffing timeline with the documented service timeline.
llm_problems.subject: Staffing timelines

locations.quote: Vetted profiles delivered in 72 hours.
First validated feature in 3 to 5 business days.

llm_problems.title: Incorrect staffing guarantee
llm_problems.issue: The schema describes staffing as having a 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee, while the documented staffing terms are a performance-based no-cost replacement if results fall below baseline and cancellation any time in the first 120 days.
llm_problems.fix: Correct the staffing guarantee to match the documented performance-based replacement and cancellation terms.
llm_problems.subject: Staffing guarantee
llm_problems.source_value: Performance-based no-cost replacement; cancel any time in first 120 days

locations.quote: 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee.

llm_problems.title: Unverified recruiting speed claims
llm_problems.issue: A 5-day shortlist and a claim of 50% faster time-to-hire than US job boards are not documented; the Fact Sheet states 4–6 weeks to offer.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify these claims and use the documented recruiting timeline.
llm_problems.subject: Recruiting timeline

locations.quote: Shortlist delivered in 5 days.
50 percent faster time-to-hire than US job boards.

llm_problems.title: Unverified network coverage
llm_problems.issue: The claim that the recruiting talent network spans more than five US-timezone countries is not supported by the Fact Sheet.
llm_problems.fix: Remove or verify the claim before including it in the schema.
llm_problems.subject: Recruiting network

locations.quote: Talent network spans 5 plus US-timezone countries.
